advisor_identified: Bert S. Hall, historian of technology at the University of Toronto Institute for the History and Philosophy of Science and Technology; supervisor of David Lawrence’s 2006 dissertation.

doctorate.title: The So-Called “Manuscript of the Hussite Wars’ Engineer” and Its Technological Milieu: A Study and Edition of Codex Latinus Monacensis 197, Part 1

evidence.says: University faculty directory identifies Bert Hall as Professor Emeritus at Toronto’s IHPST, with history of technology as his field.
Bert S. Hall’s September 2023 CV lists a PhD in History from UCLA in 1971. It also lists David Lawrence’s The Complete Soldier dissertation, Spring 2006, marked [S] in the supervision list.
CiNii Books catalogue attributes the matching Hussite Wars manuscript thesis to Bert Stewart Hall and identifies it as a reprint of his 1971 UCLA PhD thesis.
History of Science Society Newsletter, November 1972, page 7, lists Bert Hall’s matching dissertation as completed under UCLA, with Dissertation Abstracts reference 72-13,612.

notes: The institution, year, and dissertation title match the linked record. The CV and catalogue details were read in indexed source excerpts; direct page requests encountered access restrictions.
